# ETSI LoTE JSON binding

Test-only snapshot of the JSON binding referenced by ETSI TS 119 602
V1.1.1, Annex A.1. Retrieved on 11 November 2026 from
<https://forge.etsi.org/rep/esi/x19_60201_lists_of_trusted_entities>.

Repository revision: `e84f427f0cde99513b574ef4b5a155ac4a38eab6`.
The schema file's last change is `00b353a1c0112e4651837c6fc03b8fad2b914c20`.

The schema definitions retain their upstream contents; JSON whitespace is
normalized. `rfcs/rfc7517.json` is the schema's local JWK dependency.
See `LICENSE` for ETSI's redistribution terms.
The same snapshot is available in the analysis input under
`01-input/eudi/etsi/forge/1960201/`.

Passing this schema checks JSON structure; it does not establish conformance
with the normative text, the provider profiles, or JAdES.
